summary_1line: Bhishma battles Parashurama for many days, witnesses terrifying omens when Rama falls, and receives a dream revelation of the Praswapa weapon to defeat him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Parashurama collapses unconscious to his knees as meteors fall, the sun darkens under Rahu, and blood-red rain pours from storm clouds over the battlefield.
Bhishma lies wounded at night and dreams of eight radiant Brahmanas standing around him, revealing the secret Praswapa weapon.
Parashurama’s blazing dart strikes Bhishma’s shoulder like lightning, blood streaming down as the warriors face each other amid dust-darkened sunlight.
